description: WSO2 SAP Successfactors Employment Information provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsEmployeeCentral/overview). The service allows to access employment related information, including job information, employment termination, and work permit.
key-features: Access employment-related information including job details
Manage employment status, termination data, and work permits
Query job information history and employment records
